title: Three Days of Happiness
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kusunoki, a broke and aimless 20-year-old, discovers a shop that buys lifespans and learns his remaining life is valued far below average. He sells all but a few months, and the clerk Miyagi is assigned to watch him until the end, as he reconsiders how to spend the time he has left. Adapted from Sugaru Miaki's novel.
life_message: Holds up that a life's worth is found in the people you touch and how you spend your time, not in money or achievement.
